description: Watch a session by polling `sessions.preview` and return only the NEW messages that appeared during the tail window. Workaround for the stdio MCP not being able to stream `sessions.subscribe` / `session.message` events to Claude Code. Polls every `intervalMs` (default 2000ms) for up to `durationMs` (default 30000ms, max 300000ms), or until `maxMessages` new messages are collected, or until the session reaches a terminal status ('done', 'error', 'aborted', 'timeout', 'completed'). The first poll seeds the 'already-seen' set so existing messages are NOT returned — only what arrives after the tool was called.

durationMs.description: Total tail duration in ms. Default 30000 (30s). Max 300000 (5min).

instance.description: Optional OpenClaw instance to route this call to (e.g. 'default', 'work'). Falls back to the active default instance, or the OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_URL/TOKEN env vars when set. List configured instances with openclaw_setup_list.

intervalMs.description: Polling interval in ms. Default 2000 (2s). Min 500 to avoid hammering the gateway. Max 10000.

key.description: Full session key (composite, e.g. 'agent:main:cron:<id>') from openclaw_sessions_list.

maxMessages.description: Stop early once this many new messages have arrived — useful to bail out on the first agent reply.

name: openclaw_sessions_tail
